The Treatment
What Are Dermal Fillers?
Restore. Rejuvenate. Redefine.

Dermal fillers are US FDA-approved, non-surgical injectable treatments that restore lost volume, smooth fine lines and wrinkles, and beautifully contour facial features. The most widely used fillers contain hyaluronic acid â a substance naturally found in your skin that keeps it hydrated, plump, and youthful.

At ISAAC Luxe, our expert dermatologists and cosmetologists meticulously map your facial structure to deliver a natural, lifting effect with precise filler placement. These advanced fillers not only restore lost volume but also stimulate your skin's own collagen production, offering both immediate and long-term skin benefits. Whether you seek fuller lips, defined cheekbones, a sharper jawline, or refreshed under-eyes â dermal fillers at ISAAC Luxe deliver results that enhance your natural beauty without ever looking "done."

The Science
How Dermal Fillers Work
The ISAAC Luxe Filler Approach
Precision Â· Volume Â· Natural Results

Hyaluronic Acid (HA) Fillers

The gold standard in dermal fillers â JUVÃDERM and Restylane are HA-based fillers that hydrate, plump, and restore volume naturally. They are fully reversible and biodegradable, making them the safest and most versatile filler option available today.

Collagen Stimulation

Beyond immediate volume, dermal fillers stimulate the skin's natural collagen and elastin production. Over weeks and months, the skin becomes firmer, more resilient, and increasingly youthful â offering benefits that extend well beyond the filler itself.

Facial Mapping & Precision

At ISAAC Luxe, every treatment begins with a meticulous facial mapping analysis. Our dermatologists study your bone structure, facial symmetry, skin quality, and volume distribution to place filler with architectural precision â lifting and contouring exactly where needed.

Topical Anaesthesia for Comfort

A medical-grade numbing cream is applied prior to injection, ensuring the procedure is comfortable and virtually painless. Many of the filler products used at ISAAC Luxe also contain lidocaine within the formula for added comfort throughout the session.

Your Experience
The Procedure, Step by Step
What Happens During Your Session
A Guided Journey to Natural Rejuvenation
1

Personalised Consultation & Facial Assessment

Your dermatologist begins with a thorough consultation to understand your aesthetic concerns, medical history, and desired outcomes. A detailed facial mapping and symmetry analysis is conducted to identify the ideal filler type, volume, and placement for your unique facial structure.

2

Filler Selection & Treatment Planning

Based on your consultation, a bespoke treatment plan is created. The right filler product â whether JUVÃDERM, Restylane, or another premium brand â is selected for each target area based on the required density, flexibility, and longevity needed.

3

Skin Preparation & Numbing

The treatment area is thoroughly cleansed and a medical-grade topical numbing cream is applied and allowed to take effect. Your comfort is paramount â most clients describe the injections as a mild pinch at most.

4

Precise Filler Injection

Using ultra-fine needles or cannulas, your dermatologist carefully injects filler into targeted areas with clinical precision. Filler is placed in layers and massaged gently to ensure even distribution, natural integration, and a beautifully smooth result.

5

Immediate Review & Aftercare Guidance

Results are visible immediately. Your doctor reviews the outcome with you, makes any final refinements, and provides a comprehensive personalised aftercare plan to ensure your results heal beautifully and last as long as possible.

6

Follow-Up Appointment (1â2 Weeks Later)

A follow-up consultation is recommended 1â2 weeks post-treatment. This allows your doctor to assess how the filler has settled, perform any final moulding or top-up, and ensure your results are perfectly balanced and natural looking.

Your Care Guide
Pre & Post Treatment Care

Following your pre and post care instructions ensures the best possible results, minimises side effects, and maximises the longevity of your filler treatment.

â¦ Before Your Session

Avoid alcohol for 24â48 hours before your appointment to minimise bruising risk.
Do not take aspirin, ibuprofen, or blood-thinning supplements for 1 week before (unless medically required).
Avoid vigorous exercise on the day of treatment.
Stay out of direct sun and avoid tanning for one week prior.
Avoid chemical peels, laser, or microneedling for 2 weeks before.
If you have a history of cold sores (for lip fillers), inform your doctor in advance â antiviral medication may be prescribed.
Arrive with clean skin â no heavy makeup on the treatment area.

â¦ After Your Session

Avoid vigorous exercise, excessive heat, saunas, and steam for 24â48 hours post-treatment.
Do not apply heavy cosmetics or makeup to the treated area for at least 12 hours.
Avoid touching, pressing, or massaging the treated area unless advised by your doctor.
Stay hydrated â drinking plenty of water supports hyaluronic acid filler longevity.
Avoid direct sun exposure; apply SPF 30+ daily to extend results.
Mild swelling, redness, or tenderness at injection sites is normal and resolves within 2â5 days.
Attend your follow-up appointment 1â2 weeks post-treatment for review and any refinements.

Please Note: Some swelling is completely normal immediately after filler treatment. Full results become visible within 2â3 days. If you experience significant pain, unusual firmness, or any skin discolouration, contact ISAAC Luxe immediately.

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Are dermal fillers painful?

Dermal fillers at ISAAC Luxe are performed with a topical numbing cream applied beforehand, and many of our filler products also contain lidocaine for in-built comfort. Most clients describe the sensation as a mild pinch or slight pressure â very brief and well tolerated. Discomfort is minimal.

How long do dermal filler results last?

Results vary by treatment area and product used. Lip fillers typically last 3â6 months, cheek and mid-face fillers last 6â12 months, and structural fillers in the jawline and chin can last 12â18 months. JUVÃDERM Voluma in the cheeks can last up to 2 years. Touch-up sessions maintain results beautifully.

Are dermal fillers safe?

Yes. At ISAAC Luxe, only US FDA-approved hyaluronic acid fillers are used â clinically proven to be safe, effective, and biodegradable. Every treatment is performed by a qualified dermatologist or cosmetologist under strict medical supervision, ensuring the highest standard of safety at all times.

Can fillers be reversed if I don't like the result?

Absolutely. All hyaluronic acid fillers used at ISAAC Luxe are fully reversible. An enzyme called hyaluronidase can dissolve the filler quickly and safely if needed, giving you complete control over your results. This is one of the most reassuring aspects of HA filler treatment.

Is there any downtime after fillers?

There is virtually no downtime with dermal fillers. Most clients resume their normal activities immediately. Mild swelling, redness, or minor bruising at injection sites may occur but typically resolves within 2â5 days. Avoiding strenuous exercise and alcohol for 24â48 hours helps minimise these effects.

What makes ISAAC Luxe fillers different?

At ISAAC Luxe, every filler treatment is performed by a qualified dermatologist using US FDA-approved products, advanced facial mapping techniques, and a philosophy of natural enhancement. Dr. Geetika Mittal Gupta's team is dedicated to results that look refreshed, balanced, and entirely yours â never overdone.
